description.shortText: An economic framework in which the electricity generated by solar panels within a community can create proportional monetary credit to each community member.

attachments.name: Community Solar Power 101
attachments.description: Want more detailed information about community solar power? Take a look at Community Solar 101 and discover how solar panels transfer energy to the grid, how the power reaches your home, and more.

attachments.name: What is community solar? Is it better than home solar?
attachments.description: By subscribing to a community solar farm, you get the benefits of solar without having to actually buy a system of your own. Here’s how it works.

attachments.name: How Does Community Solar Billing Work?
attachments.description: 6 minutes reading this guide could save you up to 10% per year on your electric bill.

attachments.name: The Pros and Cons of Community Solar
attachments.description: There’s a lot of people that don’t have the ability to install solar panels on their own property. But there is another option; community solar.
